37: Zayit (“Olive”). Malkhut. Sometimes the seven [lower sefirotic] qualities are all [called] “olives.”
Zekhirah (“Remembrance”). From the side of Yesod.
Zekhut (“Merit”). Gevurah or Ḥesed and the essence of y[od].
Zekifah (“Standing Upright”). From the side of Tiferet.
Zeret (“Span”). Gevurah, Malkhut with her maidens.
